title: OHGLR-L01 read-back summary total outstanding with fee 0 and penalty 57.00 (penalty term alone)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the OHGLR-L01 (loan 10) loan-detail summary read-back, the complementary shape to LN-L07: the fee bucket is ZERO and the penalty bucket is NON-ZERO, so this vector discriminates the penalty term ALONE. request.summary.principal_outstanding_minor=10000000 is the capture summary's "principalOutstanding":100000.0; interest_outstanding_minor=661853 is "interestOutstanding":6618.53; fee_outstanding_minor=0 is "feeChargesOutstanding":0.0 (the loan's 100.00 fee was a due-at-disbursement charge, shown as feeChargesPaid=100.0, feeChargesOutstanding=0.0); penalty_outstanding_minor=5700 is "penaltyChargesOutstanding":57.0. expect.summary_total_minor=10667553 is "totalOutstanding":106675.53. Dropping the penalty term reads 5700 short and this vector goes red, while dropping the fee term is invisible here (fee is already zero) -- that asymmetry is exactly why a second, differently-shaped observation is needed. Nothing was computed by this promotion; the buckets and the total are transcriptions of the oracle's derived columns.

provenance.note: request.summary buckets and expect.summary_total_minor are transcribed from the "summary" block of the committed capture loan-10-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan. Loan 10 was created by the OH-GL-R run and is observed read-only here; no write of any kind touched it.
